parsed.why: No state facility ban in force; bathroom bills died in committee and two cities protect restroom use; gender-identity hate-crime recourse. Only resident-facing marker ban and a pending bill. Above the national line, still under the border regime.

Enforceable state facility-exclusion statute reaching government buildings, schools, beaches and airports, with criminal trespass and one documented arrest. Killing rate sits at background level. Materially below the national line.

Bathroom-bounty law: private suits by any person, civil and criminal penalties, licence invalidation with notices mailed, Do Not Travel tier. Private enforcement needs no prosecutor. Harshest operative visitor exposure of the five.

Hostile statutes enacted but state courts repeatedly enjoin them: facilities law restrained, marker rules blocked, care ban struck down. Working recourse for trans people lifts it above the national line despite the legislation.

Most Protective tier: shield law, gender-identity public-accommodation and hate-crime protections, custody congruent with identity, X markers. National border, passport and entry-screening regime still applies, capping the score.
